subject: Upcoming Liquidity Considerations – Request for a Meeting
body:
Dear Ms. Nguyen,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to touch base regarding your upcoming liquidity requirements, in particular the USD 5,000,000 anticipated for US university fees for your two children, due on 2026-09-01, as well as the USD 3,000,000 required from October 2026 for private equity capital calls.

Given the scale and timing of these commitments, I believe it would be valuable for us to meet and review your overall liquidity planning together, ensuring that funding sources and timelines are well coordinated across both obligations.

Please let me know a date and time that would be convenient for you, and I will arrange accordingly.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
